header.fork:
Your direction: pane agents are the default, and a native subagent is only a helper that a pane agent starts for itself, outside plugin governance.

This round turns that into requirements: where the line falls, when the default applies, who starts pane agents, what happens without a multiplexer, and three conflicts the investigations and trials found.

touches.name: The requirements
touches.anchor: PRD.md: Solution, TR-1, AC-009, AC-037, AC-038

header.size_note: Nine cards: four calls (scope, default, who starts, /afk:fix) and five confirmations.

items.decision: An agent that does a role's work is a pane agent: it writes a plugin artifact, code or a ledger, or it returns a gate verdict. An agent that only reads and returns text to its parent is a helper subagent
items.evidence: You answered role.

items.decision: Whenever the plugin is enabled and a pane transport is found on the machine. One configuration key switches back to subagents
items.evidence: You answered detected.

items.decision: Only the contact agent starts. Any other agent asks it with a start request message; the contact starts the agent and records it
items.evidence: You answered contact-only.

items.decision: The plugin still pins the helper's type and model tier, as DELEGATION.md does today
items.evidence: You answered governed-helpers.

items.decision: Pane agents for role work, and helpers for context, is a behaviour of every agent in a session where the plugin is enabled. It is stated once, where such a session always reads it, and skills point at it instead of restating it. Where it lives is design.
items.evidence: You answered accept.

items.decision: With no pane transport, or with the switch set back, role agents run as subagents and the run report says so. A subagent cannot write a report file, so in this fallback it returns its report as text and the agent that started it writes the file.
items.evidence: You answered accept.

items.decision: The gate rules stand, and pane agents must meet them. Each review round gets new reviewers that saw nothing of the build. Each reviewer returns one findings set, which the review orchestrator merges and numbers. The adversary stays blind to the diff and the tests. AC-038 is corrected: a gate worker may write its own report file that the gate names (the adversary report does today), and never the gate's status. How a pane reviewer returns its findings is design.
items.evidence: You answered accept.

items.decision: No message to an agent may change text you have typed and not sent. So a message never goes into the contact agent's input box while you may be typing. How it arrives instead is design.
items.evidence: You answered accept.

items.decision: afk-lite under /afk:fix ends where /afk:fix ends today: uncommitted changes and an OUTCOME line. The caller commits, as today
items.evidence: You answered fix-as-is.

settled_last_round: R-16: all nine answered. Role agents are pane agents by default when a pane transport is found; only the contact agent starts them; helpers keep the plugin's named types and model tiers; /afk:fix keeps its commit lane.
